note: Authoritative consolidated register. Supersedes finding_register_auditor.json, which is retained as the frozen pre-remediation baseline. Every finding here was verified directly by the primary auditor unless marked otherwise.

findings.title: Intraday monitor rejects the artifact the morning stage deliberately publishes
findings.verified_by: primary auditor (reproduced against real production artifacts)
findings.claim_tested: The 5-minute intraday monitoring loop runs and observes saved picks during the session.
findings.evidence: daily_run_stages: intraday_monitor FAILED x344 over 5 trading days. monitor_interval_gaps: 79 MISSED_INTERVAL/day, zero observed. No alpha_monitor-* or trade_watch-* log has ever existed. Dot-sourcing the live validator against the real 2026-09-03 artifact throws 'AlphaOps cycle artifact core universe is not READY'. Strict REJECT vs -AllowCoreShortfall ACCEPT reproduced for all four available days.
findings.root_cause: run_alphaops_monitor.ps1:355-358 passed neither -AllowCoreShortfall nor -RequireCoreCoverage, while run_alphaops_morning.ps1:229-236 deliberately passes -AllowCoreShortfall. The monitor consumes only research_candidate_count and research_symbols and never reads core-universe membership.
findings.impact: The entire post-morning product loop is dead: no monitoring, no entries, no outcomes, no learning.
findings.remediation: Added -AllowCoreShortfall at the monitor call site so both stages share one contract.
findings.acceptance_test: tests/test_alpha_cycle_artifact_ps1.py::test_monitor_stage_accepts_lane_local_core_shortfall (+2). Verified to FAIL against origin/main with the exact production error and PASS after the fix.
findings.residual: Production proof requires one live session (operator packet OP-1).

findings.title: Prior-day-high target published below the entry on gap-ups
findings.verified_by: primary auditor (confirmed in live database, root cause read in code)
findings.claim_tested: Every persisted trade plan has a first target above the entry.
findings.evidence: historical_signals live rows: LIDR 2026-09-01 entry 1.8090 target_1 1.17 (-35%); GPRO 2026-09-01 entry 1.5879 target_1 0.88 (-45%); PPBT 2026-09-02 entry 3.0150 target_1 1.68 (-44%). alpha_cycle_service.py assigned output['target_1'] = prior_high unconditionally under basis prior_day_resistance.
findings.root_cause: The prior-day high is only resistance while it is above the entry. On a gap up the premarket high has already cleared yesterday's high, so the assignment inverts the plan. The existing geometry guard validated the premarket range but not the target relation.
findings.impact: Latent critical. No user was alerted: all three rows carry was_alerted=0 and signal_label 'NO CLEAN EDGE', blocked by the unrelated gate 'SEC risk not checked'. Had that gate passed, an inverted plan was alertable. The rows remain persisted and displayable.
findings.remediation: Added 'or prior_high <= high' to the existing guard so the structure is refused exactly as an absent observation is, yielding NO_VALID_PLAN.
findings.acceptance_test: tests/test_alphaops_prior_day_target_geometry.py (3 tests: control, LIDR gap-up geometry, equal-to-entry boundary). Verified to FAIL against origin/main and PASS after the fix; the control passes in both states.

findings.title: Suite does not pass at the authoritative commit: 61 failures
findings.claim_tested: The repository's test suite passes at origin/main.
findings.evidence: 5,150 collected / 5,083 passed / 61 failed / 6 skipped / exit 1. Families: A anyio lock drift (35), B stale approved-interpreter hash (~16), C date-dependent test (3), D Streamlit AppTest path (3).
findings.root_cause: Environment identity is pinned by assertion but not by installation, and the approved interpreter hash was never rotated after a Python patch upgrade.
findings.impact: No reproducible green suite, so no certification gate can pass. Notably, no failure indicates a defect in scanning, scoring, monitoring, outcome or learning logic.
findings.remediation: Family D fixed (DS-004). Families A and B are owner decisions (DS-005, DS-006). Family C needs a date-independent fixture.
findings.acceptance_test: Full suite exits 0 on a clean environment built by the documented procedure.

findings.title: The only Streamlit dashboard render test was broken; the dashboard itself is correct
findings.claim_tested: The primary user interface has working automated verification.
findings.evidence: AppTest.from_file('app.py') resolved to tests/app.py under streamlit 1.63.0 and raised FileNotFoundError. Driving AppTest with an absolute path renders all five tabs with no exception, does not create the database, and emits the correct warnings including 'Evidence is insufficient until at least 20 real market days are audited.'
findings.root_cause: AppTest.from_file resolves relative paths against the calling file; pyproject pins only streamlit>=1.32 so the behaviour change was admitted silently.
findings.impact: The dashboard had no passing regression guard. The application was never broken.
findings.remediation: Resolve app.py absolutely from the repository root; raise the timeout to 90s.
findings.acceptance_test: tests/test_streamlit_app.py passes on streamlit 1.63.0. Verified: 1 passed, exit 0.

findings.title: The documented install cannot produce a suite-passing environment
findings.claim_tested: Following the documented installation yields a working, verifiable environment.
findings.evidence: A fresh venv running 'py -m pip install -e .[dev]' installs successfully (exit 0) but resolves anyio 4.15.0 against requirements.lock's anyio==4.14.2, and fails tests/test_dawnstrike_python_bootstrap.py with the identical assertion seen in the full run. The documented path never consults the lock.
findings.root_cause: A strict hash-bearing lock is maintained and asserted against, but no install step enforces it; pyproject declares only loose floors.
findings.impact: 35 of 61 failures. Any operator following the README today gets a failing environment.
findings.remediation: OWNER DECISION: (a) hold the baseline and install from the lock (--require-hashes), updating the docs; or (b) advance the lock to admit 4.15.0. Do not weaken the contract test.
findings.acceptance_test: A clean venv built by the documented procedure passes tests/test_dawnstrike_python_bootstrap.py.

findings.title: Approved-interpreter identity is stale after a Python patch upgrade
findings.claim_tested: The runtime activation trust boundary admits the current supported interpreter.
findings.evidence: runtime_activation_lock.ps1:4 pins ef8f51028ac5329641985112f8efb1c2d4c47c86b8011ddf7e6fae21e2b4e5a1; the host python.exe hashes to 85B71D8C6EC1905935F74BE0C9869AAE198D00E98F39DF699EC66F9C5A84CECD (Python 3.13.15, built 2026-08-05). ~16 tests fail with 'Approved lock-contract interpreter hash changed.'
findings.root_cause: The pin targets Python 3.13.14 and no rotation procedure exists. The control itself is correct and is a stronger supply-chain guard than most projects attempt.
findings.impact: ~16 test failures, and very likely the reason the production runtime is still pinned at b7220890 rather than tracking origin/main.
findings.remediation: OWNER DECISION: a documented rotation runbook (verify Authenticode signer and thumbprint, record the new SHA-256 with provenance, update the pin, re-run the activation suite). An auditor must not silently widen a trust boundary.
findings.acceptance_test: Activation suite passes on the supported interpreter with a recorded provenance entry.

findings.title: Paper audit defaults to unconditional open entry while the strategy requires breakout confirmation
findings.claim_tested: Simulated entries obey the strategy's own entry rule (mission historical concern #10).
findings.evidence: audit_service.py:151-164; default entry_mode='open' at config.py:70, config.py:302, paper_audit.py:19 and .env.example. Live entry_condition text reads 'Watch only if price confirms above 1.809.' When 'breakout' IS selected the implementation is correct and conservative: first bar whose high reaches the trigger, filled at max(trigger, bar.open), no forced fill if never touched.
findings.root_cause: A misaligned default, not broken machinery.
findings.impact: Default simulations fill trades the strategy would never take and delete the confirmation selection effect, distorting any result derived from them.
findings.remediation: Default to 'breakout', or refuse to emit results for a confirmation strategy under 'open' without labeling them unconditional-entry simulations. Also make _breakout_entry_index refuse a non-positive trigger instead of returning index 0 (audit_service.py:332-333).
findings.acceptance_test: A confirmation-strategy paper audit run without an explicit entry-mode uses breakout fills, and a zero trigger is refused rather than silently degraded.

findings.title: Production runs a polled spot-price model; the correct path-accurate engine has no production caller
findings.evidence: evaluate_position_management has zero non-test callers outside v2/paper_ops; trade_watcher_service.py never references it. _exit_decision (1838-1877) and the entry path (~1749-1790) both consume a single scalar price from a 5-minute observation bundle. By contrast position_management.py:140-205 raises ValueError on a pre-open bar, applies same_bar_policy 'stop_first_conservative', and exits gap-throughs at bar.open.
findings.root_cause: Two engines of different fidelity; the lower-fidelity one is in production.
findings.impact: Production cannot see a stop or target touched between polls and fills at the poll price rather than the level. For sub-$25 gappers this is a large blind spot. Production paper results must never be presented as path-accurate.
findings.remediation: Route production exits through evaluate_position_management against retained one-minute bars, or explicitly label production paper results as poll-resolution estimates with an accounted intrabar blind spot. Escalation trigger: changes what the product measures.
findings.acceptance_test: Either production exits reconcile against a path replay of the same session, or every surface presenting production paper results carries the poll-resolution qualifier.

findings.title: Registered scheduled task is incompatible with the monitor script at origin/main
findings.claim_tested: The current head can be deployed to the existing runtime without changing task registration.
findings.evidence: The live task passes only -RuntimeRoot and -StateRoot. The runtime (b7220890) monitor has four optional params. origin/main adds three Mandatory params: ExpectedSha, LaunchManifestPath, LaunchManifestSha256.
findings.root_cause: Task registration and stage-script signatures evolved on separate cadences.
findings.impact: A routine runtime upgrade would silently break the scheduled pipeline — including the WP-1 fix deployment.
findings.remediation: Re-register tasks as part of the documented upgrade, and add a preflight validating every registered task's arguments against the target commit's parameter signatures.
findings.acceptance_test: A preflight that fails when a registered task omits a mandatory parameter of the target commit's stage script.

findings.title: win_probability_pct returns 100.0 on zero evidence
findings.claim_tested: User-visible probability values are supported by their underlying evidence.
findings.evidence: estimate_expectancy(cand, []) with zero audit history returns sample_size=0, effective_sample_size=0.0, model_basis='score prior only', win_probability_pct=100.0, alongside a lower bound of -14.88% — internally contradictory. All prior weight sits on a positive heuristic prior.
findings.root_cause: _win_probability computes a weighted share of positive returns over a weight set containing only the prior.
findings.impact: MEDIUM, not HIGH: the value is NEVER rendered. It is absent from EXPECTANCY_COLUMNS (app.py:113-121) and from both per-ticker render sites (app.py:2496-2508, 4460-4485). It is a latent trap: a field named win_probability_pct will eventually be displayed by someone.
findings.remediation: Return None (or omit the field) when empirical_count == 0, or rename it to reflect that it is a prior-weighted share rather than a probability.
findings.acceptance_test: estimate_expectancy with zero audit rows yields no win-probability value, or one explicitly marked unavailable.

findings.title: Setup card shows a bare Expected % with no basis, tier or confidence qualifier
findings.claim_tested: Every surface presenting an expected return carries its evidentiary qualifier.
findings.evidence: The expectancy table (EXPECTANCY_COLUMNS) includes an explanation reading 'Basis: score prior only; tier: exploratory. Run paper audits for this scanner output.' The setup card grid (app.py:4460-4485) renders only ticker, rank, Score, Watch, Risk, Target and 'Expected +4.99%' — no confidence, tier or basis.
findings.root_cause: The qualifier exists but is not carried onto the most prominent surface.
findings.impact: A user scanning cards sees an authoritative-looking expected return with zero indication it derives from a heuristic prior on zero evidence.
findings.remediation: Add the confidence tier (or an 'exploratory / no sample' badge) to the card whenever empirical_count is below the sample threshold.
findings.acceptance_test: A card rendered from an estimate with sample_size 0 displays an explicit insufficient-evidence marker.

findings.title: config_hash incorporates local filesystem paths
findings.verified_by: primary auditor and independently by a second reviewer (SCAN-06)
findings.claim_tested: config_hash is a stable fingerprint of scoring configuration comparable across runs.
findings.evidence: Two scans differing only in --out-dir and --db-path produced identical values in every ranked_candidates.csv column except config_hash (e464382b3509 vs b35f68c75312). Changing only --out-dir also changed it (2e59adc5acdf). Identical paths reproduced it exactly twice (1885ac5b81d9). scoring.py:407-409 hashes config.public_dict(), which includes database_path and output_dir.
findings.root_cause: public_dict() conflates runtime I/O settings with strategy configuration.
findings.impact: Path-sensitive, not nondeterministic. It cannot be compared across machines or output directories, defeating its provenance purpose. No score, rank or level is affected.
findings.remediation: Hash only the strategy/scoring-relevant subset, or emit a separate strategy_config_hash.
findings.acceptance_test: Two scans differing only in --out-dir/--db-path produce an identical strategy configuration hash.

findings.title: Date-dependent test cannot serve as a certification gate
findings.claim_tested: Test outcomes are independent of the date they run.
findings.evidence: DataTruthAcquisitionIncomplete: CSV source symbol TST lacks exact completed bar 2026-09-04 — the assertion references the execution date.
findings.root_cause: A fixture anchored to the current date rather than a frozen one.
findings.impact: A suite that passes on one date and fails on another cannot gate a release.
findings.remediation: Freeze the fixture date or inject a clock.
findings.acceptance_test: The test passes on any execution date.

findings.title: Zero trades in 25 forward paper-trading days: no demonstrated edge exists
findings.claim_tested: Dawnstrike has produced credible evidence that its insights outperform alternatives after realistic costs.
findings.evidence: paper_account_daily_ledger, official_forward_paper, 2026-07-31..2026-09-03 = 25 trading days: 21 MISSING, 4 NO_TRADE, trade_count 0 on every row, target_return_pct 1.0 with target_status PENDING throughout. signal_outcomes, paper_positions, paper_trade_fills, paper_audit_trades, manual_outcomes, alpha_outcome_labels, alpha_v6_outcomes, strategy_learning_labels, alpha_learning_runs, trade_intents, committed_fill_truth_receipts, outcome_capture_attempts all 0 rows. 105 of 145 tables empty.
findings.root_cause: Downstream starvation from DS-001, plus a strategy that selected no qualifying entry on any observed day.
findings.impact: Verdict C is determinable without statistical analysis: there is nothing to analyse. No performance claim of any kind is supportable.
findings.remediation: Deploy DS-001, then accumulate completed outcomes. Edge evaluation cannot begin before the loop closes.
findings.acceptance_test: A non-zero count of completed, cost-adjusted paper outcomes across a pre-registered sample of trading days.

findings.title: Truth discipline is real and verified in production
findings.claim_tested: Dawnstrike refuses to fabricate or overstate evidence.
findings.evidence: Unobserved monitor slots persist as explicit MISSED_INTERVAL receipts carrying missing_is_not_zero: true. No-trade days record return_basis 'explicit_no_trade_observed_zero' with observed_zero true, while MISSING days keep net_return_pct NULL — the two are never conflated. Daily finalize 2026-09-03 returned status DEGRADED, upstream_status failed, deployment_url null, next_action 'missing_or_degraded_upstream_truth_or_safety' — it refused to publish to the public dashboard. stage_failure_notification receipts show sent: true on 08-31, 09-01, 09-02, 09-03. The dashboard on an empty database warns 'Evidence is insufficient until at least 20 real market days are audited.' and does not create the database. Every receipt carries research_only: true and broker_execution_enabled: false.
findings.impact: The most defensible property of the product and the principal reason the codebase is salvageable. It is also the strongest competitive differentiator found.
findings.remediation: Protect it. No remediation may weaken the fail-visible contract. The DS-001 fix deliberately narrows one caller's strictness rather than loosening the shared validator.
findings.acceptance_test: Regression tests asserting missing != zero and refuse-to-publish-degraded remain green after remediation.

findings.title: Backtest Sortino divides by dispersion among losses, not downside deviation
findings.verified_by: primary auditor (read and executed); originally raised as STAT-03 by a subagent
findings.claim_tested: Reported Sortino is the textbook downside-deviation ratio.
findings.evidence: engine.py:537-538 computes downside = [v for v in daily_returns if v < 0] then pstdev(downside)*sqrt(252) — the population standard deviation of the losses about THEIR OWN MEAN, not the root-mean-square of negative deviations from the target over all periods. Executed on a realistic stop-loss series (losses clustered near -1R): engine downside_vol 0.0011225 vs textbook 0.10040171; engine Sortino 4714.49 vs textbook 52.71 = 89x overstated.
findings.root_cause: Dispersion among losers substituted for magnitude of losses.
findings.impact: The metric degrades exactly as risk control improves: the tighter the loss clustering, the smaller pstdev(downside) and the larger the reported Sortino. Perfectly consistent losses give pstdev = 0, so Sortino returns None. This is an inverted incentive. Impact is bounded because sortino is NOT consumed by any promotion gate — it appears nowhere in challenger_evaluation.py or promotion_policy.py — but it IS reachable and displayable via the strategy-challenger-backtest CLI.
findings.remediation: Compute downside deviation as sqrt(mean(min(r - MAR, 0)^2)) over all periods.
findings.acceptance_test: A unit test comparing the engine's sortino against a hand-computed downside-deviation ratio on a fixed return series.

findings.title: Backtest annualization hardcodes sqrt(252) over per-bar returns
findings.verified_by: primary auditor; originally raised as STAT-05 by a subagent
findings.claim_tested: Risk-adjusted metrics annualize according to the data's actual bar timeframe.
findings.evidence: engine.py:534-540: daily_returns = _equity_returns(equity_curve) are per-EQUITY-POINT (i.e. per-bar) returns despite the name; volatility = pstdev(daily_returns)*sqrt(252) and sharpe = (average_daily_return*252)/volatility, with 252 hardcoded and no timeframe parameter or guard. The ratio reduces to avg_per_bar*sqrt(252)/pstdev_per_bar, whereas per-bar data with N bars/day requires avg_per_bar*sqrt(252*N)/pstdev_per_bar — so feeding 1-minute bars UNDERSTATES Sharpe by sqrt(390) ~ 19.7x. Separately _annualized_return (engine.py:795-806) uses days = max((end-start).days, 1) over 365.25 with no minimum-window guard, so a single-day backtest compounds to an absurd CAGR, which calmar then inherits.
findings.root_cause: A daily-bar assumption baked into a generic engine, plus a misleading variable name.
findings.impact: Bounded for the same reason as DS-016: sharpe and calmar are not consumed by any promotion gate. They are reachable and displayable via strategy-challenger-backtest. The newer v2/backtest/intraday_engine.py does NOT repeat the defect.
findings.remediation: Parameterize periods-per-year from the bar timeframe, rename daily_returns to period_returns, refuse to annualize below a minimum window, and mark unsupported irregular sampling NOT_ANNUALIZABLE.
findings.acceptance_test: Feeding 1-minute bars produces either a correctly scaled Sharpe or an explicit NOT_ANNUALIZABLE result, and a sub-window backtest refuses to report a CAGR.

findings.title: Remaining statistical hypotheses raised but NOT verified
findings.verified_by: subagent only; adversarial verification did NOT complete
findings.claim_tested: Risk-adjusted metric implementations are numerically correct.
findings.evidence: Raised with cited lines but NOT confirmed by me: deflated Sharpe mixing annualized Sharpe with a per-period standard error (claimed to saturate at 1.0); multiple-testing haircut ~16x too small; no minimum-sample gate in evaluate_return_predictions (claimed n=3 yields EVALUABLE with Sharpe 38.9); profit-factor sentinel of 1,000,000 earning promotion score points; walk-forward consistency as a 2-of-3 sign test; annualized_observation_sharpe annualizing over traded days only.
findings.impact: If real, these sit on the V6 promotion path. All V6 evaluation tables are currently empty, so nothing is being mis-reported to a user today. Note that the two hypotheses I DID verify (DS-016, DS-017) were both real but had their severity overstated by the subagent, so treat the remainder as plausible but unconfirmed.
findings.remediation: Verify each against the code before actioning any. Treat as hypotheses, not findings.
findings.acceptance_test: Numeric-correctness tests for the multiple-testing penalty, the deflated Sharpe, and the sample-size gate against hand-computed fixtures.
